sourceText: User requested splitting the DONE prepare/review-assurance UX work into three stories and developing each to DONE; this story covers surfacing review-assurance requirements before DONE closeout.
normalizedOutcome: B-eb92 makes review-assurance requirements visible before DONE from the canonical gate predicate and makes done_prepare review-assurance blockers actionable without owner self-signing evidence.
acceptanceClaim: For a triggered review-assurance fixture, CLI surfaces before DONE include canonical reason/material binding/legal-writer/fallback/cannot-auto-sign guidance, and done_prepare prints safe blocker next steps while preserving the existing DONE gate.
